verdict.rationale: Zoho Books' own feature docs say it connects to bank and credit-card accounts and automatically imports transactions through bank feeds that flow in without manual work, which is the core of this story. Missing for 10: documentation that the feed import runs on a daily (or other stated) schedule, details on supported banks or feed providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: Zoho Books enhances banking efficiency by enabling your business to connect with bank and credit card accounts. Automatically import transactions, categorise them, and streamline the reconciliation process for swift month-end closing
